notes: Stabilizes the 1.7 command-center redesign by removing the 1.7.0 overlay architecture rather than stacking another UI on top. The release boots directly from the proven 1.6.5 functional runtime, strips the persisted 1.7.0 injected UI code, hard-hides the legacy visual shell, and mounts one controlled Chat view and one controlled Live view with a single internal mode state. Chat and Live no longer synchronize by repeatedly finding and clicking hidden legacy mode controls. The real chat log, composer, attachments and send/Stop behavior are mounted into the new Chat view so existing persistence and model behavior are retained. Live retains current chat/project/work state, recent conversation, active-work progress, Preview, Start Live, Voice and typed input. Existing posters, presentations, Preview/Edit, downloads/exports, Pocket TTS, Stop, projects/history, AI Search, attachments/document extraction/image vision and multi-source research remain on the 1.6.5 functional core. All visible in-app A.C.E. branding now uses the user-supplied green gear logo in the header, rail and Live view. Python, decompressed JavaScript, legacy-overlay removal rules and exact release hashes were verified from fresh GitHub checkouts before publication.
